title: Ring Floodlight Cam Wired Plus (Black/White) $89 + Delivery @ JB Hi-Fi
body:

[GoIdDigger] Anyone have recommendations for a floodlight cam that stores recordings locally like a dashcam?
[kkp4deals] The current sales approach for many of these products is to offer the initial solution at a relatively low cost and generate ongoing revenue through recurring subscription fees. Personally, I prefer solutions that provide local storage capabilities and do not rely on subscription-based licensing.
